3. description: trim it; at most 200 characters and no '\n' or '\r', else BadRequest("The description is one line of at most 200 characters.").
4. about: trim it; at most crate::overview::ABOUT_MAX bytes (.len()), else BadRequest("The about text is at most 20,000 bytes.").
5. links: let links_json = clean_links(l)? (clean_links already exists in this file).
Check ALL four first (steps 1-5), then write each given one with its own `UPDATE projects SET name = ? WHERE id = ?` / description / about / links (bind the trimmed value or links_json, then &id) using sqlx::query(...).bind(...).bind(&id).execute(&s.db).await?. Keep everything that follows (type, repo, overseer, archived, the Changed event) as it is.
